caption: The drawing features a grandfather clock prominently centered against a plain, light beige background. The clock case is constructed from wood, depicted in a rich, medium brown color with a visible wood grain texture. The top of the clock has a curved, ornate pediment with a decorative finial in the center. The clock face is circular with a brass or gold color and has black Roman numerals arranged around its edge, as well as two black clock hands, one longer than the other. The clock face is set in a squared section with beveled edges. The lower part of the case is rectangular and features decorative vertical columns on each side and a central door with an arched design inset, flanked by two small columns. There is a circular brass or gold handle or ornament on the door. The overall composition of the drawing is simple, with the clock depicted in a three-quarter view and no additional objects or details in the background. There is a signature by the artist in the lower left corner of the image area.
title: Shelf Clock
